name: geqo_pool_size
description: Number of individuals in the genetic population used by the Genetic Query Optimizer (GEQO) for exploring query plans.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for complex joins
Excessive planning time for large queries
Poor performance on queries with many joined tables
Inconsistent plan selection across similar queries
tuning_tips: Set to 100–1000 for complex multi-join queries; leave at 0 to let PostgreSQL auto-select based on geqo_effort and table count. Increase only if GEQO produces poor plans and planning time is acceptable.
default_formula: 0 (auto-selected as function of geqo_effort and number of tables)
